stories.title: Define Health Check Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a standardized response schema for health endpoints including overall status (ok/degraded/down), timestamp, service name, and dependency-level checks (e.g., MongoDB). Ensure consistent JSON structure for monitoring and DevOps consumption.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py; ASSUMPTION: No existing health schema defined; GAP required

stories.title: Implement Core Health Evaluation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including liveness (process up) and readiness (dependency availability such as MongoDB). Include per-dependency checks with timeout safeguards and structured aggregation aligned to the schema.

stories.title: Expose Health Endpoints via FastAPI
stories.description: Add /health (aggregate), /health/live (liveness), and /health/ready (readiness) endpoints to the FastAPI application in main.py. Each endpoint invokes appropriate health logic and returns the standardized response with low latency and no authentication.

stories.title: Health Check Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for health evaluation logic and integration tests for all health endpoints validating schema compliance, success and failure scenarios (e.g., simulated DB outage), timeout handling, and HTTP status codes.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/; ASSUMPTION: No existing health tests; GAP required

stories.title: Health Check Logging and Observability Integration
stories.description: Integrate health endpoint execution with debug logging to capture invocation metrics and dependency status outcomes without exposing sensitive information, supporting operational monitoring and troubleshooting.
